title: 第17章 刘家翻脸康允站队第18章 生死之战一剑秒杀
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“怎么……可……能……”
刘建挣扎着从地上站起身来，满脸狰狞。
他施展出来的可是归元剑宗的黄级极品掌法。
为何会败给林雨菲。
“建儿，没事吧？”
刘畅很快就出现在刘建身边，赶紧将对方扶起来。
感受到刘建身上混乱的气息，明显受伤不轻。
刘建可是他们刘家未来的希望，现在被林雨菲重创。
若是无法康复，对刘家的打击不亚于丢失灵石矿脉三年开采权。
“爹！
林家哪里来的这么厉害的剑法？”
刘建睚眦欲裂，咬牙切齿。
他好不容易去了归元剑宗，才能够获得黄级极品掌法修炼。
林雨菲刚才施展的剑法，至少也是玄级以上的剑法。
“哼！”
刘畅冷哼一声，面色阴沉。
“林毅，你女儿下手这么重，你是不是应该给我个交代？”
刘畅紧接着目光冰冷的看向林毅。
内心都是愤怒和不甘。
他也没想到林雨菲变得这么强。

“呵呵！
你儿子技不如人，反过来怪我女儿下手狠？”
林毅也已经来到林雨菲身前，将女儿护在身后。
他的目光凝重。
父亲闭关修炼这么多天，依旧没有出关。
现在林家就只有他这个刚突破的通神境，若是刘家真的动手，对他们很不利。
林旭和林坚也很快出现在林毅身后，身上的灵力也流动起来。
“哼！
既然你们林家这么嚣张，我们刘家也没必要遮掩。”
刘畅双眸深处弥漫着杀意。
他瞥见坐在主座的康允，并没有下场的意思。
况且。
现在林家的最强者林明义也不在。
刘家除了他是通神境二重境界，还有通神境五重巅峰的刘佐，以及通神境五重的刘叶。
全力出手，很快就能够将林雨菲抹杀。
木秀于林风必摧之。
林雨菲的崛起，对刘家来说可不是好事情。
随着刘畅话音刚落。
两个老者速度很快，就来到刘畅身边。
“你们刘家这是准备撕毁三家大比协议？”

林毅身上灵力流动。
神色也变的凝重。
content_en:
"How...can...can..."
Liu Jian struggled to stand up from the ground, with a ferocious look on his face.
What he displayed was the Huang-level top-notch palm technique of Guiyuan Sword Sect.
Why did he lose to Lin Yufei?
"Jian'er, are you okay?"
Liu Chang soon appeared next to Liu Jian and quickly helped him up.
Feeling the chaotic aura on Liu Jian's body, he was obviously seriously injured.
Liu Jian was the hope for the future of their Liu family, but now he was hit hard by Lin Yufei.
If he cannot recover, the blow to the Liu family will be no less than losing the three-year mining rights of the Lingshi mine.
"Dad!
Where did the Lin family get such powerful swordsmanship? "
Liu Jian's eyes were about to burst and he was gnashing his teeth.
He finally went to Guiyuan Sword Sect and was able to obtain the best yellow-level palm skills.
The swordsmanship Lin Yufei performed just now was at least a swordsmanship above Xuan level.
"Hmph!"
Liu Chang snorted coldly, his expression gloomy.
"Jin Yi, your daughter has been so harsh, should you give me an explanation?"
Liu Chang then looked at Ji Yi with cold eyes.
My heart is full of anger and unwillingness.
He didn't expect Lin Yufei to become so strong.
"Haha!
Your son is not as good as others, and you blame my daughter for being cruel? "
Lin Yi has also arrived in front of Lin Yufei, protecting his daughter behind him.
His eyes were serious.
My father has been practicing in seclusion for so many days and still has not come out.
Now the Lin family is the only one who has just broken through to the realm of gods. If the Liu family really takes action, it will be very detrimental to them.
Lin Xu and Lin Jian soon appeared behind Lin Yi, and their spiritual power began to flow.
"Hmph!
Since your Lin family is so arrogant, there is no need for our Liu family to cover up. "
Liu Chang's eyes were filled with murderous intent.
He caught a glimpse of Kang Yun sitting in the main seat and had no intention of giving up.
Moreover.
Now Lin Mingyi, the strongest person in the Lin family, is not here either.
In addition to him, who is at the second level of the Tongshen Realm, the Liu family also has Liu Zuo, who is at the peak of the fifth level of the Tongshen Realm, and Liu Ye, who is at the fifth level of the Tongshen Realm.
With all his strength, Lin Yufei was quickly wiped out.
Any tree that is beautiful in the forest will be destroyed by the wind.
The rise of Lin Yufei is not a good thing for the Liu family.
As soon as Liu Chang finished speaking.
The two old men arrived at Liu Chang's side very quickly.
"Are your Liu family planning to tear up the three-family competition agreement?"
Lin Yi's spiritual power flows.
His expression also became serious.
